_comment: Maintained in the TraitorDash repository (pelican/). Import it in the panel under Admin > Eggs.
name: TraitorDash
author: TheFehr
description: TraitorDash: web dashboard for configuring a GMod TTT2 server (Bun + Hono + SQLite). The app files are deployed into the server's volume; this egg only runs them.

startup_commands.Default: if [ -f /home/container/package.json ]; then bun install --production --frozen-lockfile; fi; bun run {{MAIN_FILE}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# TraitorDash installation
#
# Nothing to download: the app is deployed into /mnt/server (the server's files) by the
# homelab-infrastructure `traitordash` Ansible role, and its dependencies are installed by the
# startup command (bun install). This only makes sure the directory exists.
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo "TraitorDash: nothing to install; deploy the app files, then start the server."

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: The address the dashboard is reached at, e.g. https://traitordash.example.com (no path; a trailing slash is ignored). Steam sends admins back to it after login, so it must be the address in their browser.

variables.name: Admin SteamID64s
variables.description: Comma-separated SteamID64s allowed to administer. Empty means nobody can log in.

variables.name: Session Secret
variables.description: Random string of at least 32 characters used to sign login sessions (openssl rand -hex 32). The app refuses to start without it. Change it to log everyone out.

variables.name: Node Environment
variables.description: production enables Secure cookies. Use development only on a trusted local network.
